scenes.headline: How to price a room-temperature superconductor
scenes.sub: A ceiling for phonon pairing, and a model that admits its limits
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Cooper! A tiny lab in San Francisco is chasing a room-temperature superconductor. Its first result is not a candidate. It is a ceiling.

scenes.text: When phonons pair the electrons, one quantity caps the transition temperature, and no hydride calculated at one atmosphere has enough of it.
scenes.mark: one quantity caps the transition temperature
scenes.say: When lattice vibrations pair the electrons, one quantity caps the transition temperature. No hydride calculated at one atmosphere has enough of it.

scenes.title: The ceiling, term by term
scenes.say: Strong-coupling theory gives a simple limit.

parts.note: hydrogen's coupling; phonon frequencies cancel out of it
parts.say: Under the root is hydrogen's Hopfield parameter. Phonon frequencies cancel out of it.

parts.note: the large-coupling limit, in hydrogen units
parts.say: This constant turns it into kelvin. Room temperature needs at least four point eight three.

parts.note: efficiency, below one in every solution
parts.say: Real spectra reach only a third to a half of the ceiling.

steps.say: Split that coupling in two: how densely protons are packed, and how hard each one pulls on the electrons.
Multiply them for the Hopfield parameter.
Megabar hydrides don't pull harder per proton. Pressure packs five to six times more of them in. That's why they need a million atmospheres.
The lab measured this for four thousand six hundred nineteen hydrides at one atmosphere.
Megabar hydrides sit up here, in the band three hundred kelvin needs.
The best at one atmosphere reaches five point six. Below the band, and sensitive to a setting nobody has converged.

scenes.title: The model ranks; it does not predict Tc

items.say: Trees and a graph network each estimate.
Out comes the Hopfield sum, an upper scale, never a transition temperature.
Every answer carries a flag: in a test fixed in advance, it could not predict above its training range.

scenes.text: For phonon pairing, room temperature is a budget: enough hydrogen coupling, packed densely, in a phase that survives one atmosphere.
scenes.mark: in a phase that survives one atmosphere
scenes.say: Room temperature is a budget: enough coupling, packed densely, in a phase that survives one atmosphere. Nobody has all three yet.
